checks.text: The page shows the heading "Daily Journal App", a status bar containing "Saved", and an empty editor area with the placeholder text "Write your entry…".
Typing "Buy milk" into the editor area and pressing Ctrl+S shows "Saved" in the status bar; the rendered preview pane shows the text "Buy milk".
Typing "- [ ] Task A" into the editor area, then clicking the checkbox next to "Task A" in the preview pane, changes the editor text to "- [x] Task A" and the status bar shows "Saved".

Clicking the button "Lock entry" opens a dialog with a field labelled "Passphrase"; typing "secret123" and clicking "Encrypt" changes the status bar to "Encrypted" and the editor area becomes read-only with the text "Locked".

With the entry locked, clicking the button "Unlock entry" opens a dialog with a field labelled "Passphrase"; typing "wrongpass" and clicking "Decrypt" shows the message "Invalid passphrase" in the dialog and the status bar remains "Encrypted".

With the entry locked, clicking "Unlock entry", typing "secret123" in the field labelled "Passphrase" and clicking "Decrypt" restores the editor text to "- [x] Task A", makes the editor editable, and the status bar shows "Saved".
Clicking the button "Export backup" triggers a file download named "journal-backup.json" whose content includes the key "version" with value 1 and the entry text "- [x] Task A".

After exporting, deleting the entry text, typing "New day" into the editor, and clicking the button "Import backup" with the previously exported file restores the editor text to "- [x] Task A" and the status bar shows "Saved".
Reload keeps the entry: after typing "Buy milk" and reloading the page, the editor area contains "Buy milk" and the status bar shows "Saved".
